title: Contract with the Muse
paragraphs:
I:
Идут цепные псы, все в красных камизельках...
Соскучились сидеть одиннадцать часов...
Кнутом меня - "пошёл! Что вылупил глазеньки?"
А я уж чуть ползу... Катится колесо...

I:
Damn... What a scenario I spun in my head, Friend! A tearful forewoman comes up to me - why are You so cruel to me? And my poem became the anthem of LPP) I - Did you see yourself in my poem? That should have flattered you, not upset you... She - you know nothing about me, about my situation, to judge like that! I - and I don't judge, darling... It's just that You have such a contract with LPP, and I have such a one with the Muse...
